name: project-overview-dashboard-fit
goal: Keep the signed-in Hub dashboard cards, filters and document inside each supported viewport.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The compiled Hub 5154504400 phone capture projects-owner-mobile.png shows the right edge of the signed-in /projects tracker card clipped at 390px. Desktop, tablet and phone retain the full card area and an internally scrollable filter strip.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing account-projects owner state asserted card visibility and saved a viewport screenshot without comparing document width or card bounds. The standalone tracker-overview geometry test exercised another route. The existing owner state now requires both width and card bounds at each viewport.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At ca2c58e11f Workerd reproduced 236px document overflow and five clipped cards on mobile. Sealed record 4ad38e5ac284. Desktop and tablet passed the unchanged check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Haiku put the Hub overview panel inside its grid track. The CSS-only fix is f4e9c19462.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged complete test corpus passed on all three widths. Sealed record ff649563555d retained hash-verified and inspected captures.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The integrated stamped Workerd Hub 441e8f7108 passed all 70 focused browser cases and retained final state captures and workload readings. Full-root validation is tracked separately.
